arxiv-1811-10913.title: On the Relationship between Classical and Deformed Hopf Fibrations This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Noncommutative Manifolds and their Symmetries in honour of Giovanni Landi. The full collection is available at https://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/Landi.html
arxiv-1811-10913.creator: Tomasz BRZEZIŃSKI †‡, James GAUNT § and Alexander SCHENKEL §
arxiv-1811-10913.description: Abstract The θ \theta -deformed Hopf fibration 𝕊 θ 3 → 𝕊 2 \mathbb{S}^{3}_{\theta}\to\mathbb{S}^{2} over the commutative 2 2 -sphere is compared with its classical counterpart. It is shown that there exists a natural isomorphism between the corresponding associated module functors and that the affine spaces of classical and deformed connections are isomorphic.

arxiv-2105-00384.title: A Systematic Review of Security in the LoRaWAN Network Protocol DOI: XX.XXXX/XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Journal: CSUR Volume: 30 3 102 3 CCS: Security and privacy Security protocols
arxiv-2105-00384.creator: Poliana de Moraes, Arlindo Flavio da Conceição
arxiv-2105-00384.description: Abstract . The age of the Internet of Things is adding an increasing number of new devices to the Internet and is expected to have fifty billion connected units by 2021. These form an extensive network that may have multiple points where there is a risk of attacks that can compromise the entire system.

arxiv-2107-08795.title: Federated Learning with Dynamic Transformer for Text to Speech
arxiv-2107-08795.creator: Zhenhou Hong, Jianzong Wang*, Xiaoyang Qu, Jie Liu, Chendong Zhao, Jing Xiao
arxiv-2107-08795.description: Abstract Text to speech (TTS) is a crucial task for user interaction, but TTS model training relies on a sizable set of high-quality original datasets. Due to privacy and security issues, the original datasets are usually unavailable directly. Recently, federated learning proposes a popular distributed machine learning paradigm with an enhanced privacy protection mechanism.

arxiv-2110-15263.title: Coresets for Time Series Clustering
arxiv-2110-15263.creator: Lingxiao Huang, K. Sudhir, Nisheeth K. Vishnoi
arxiv-2110-15263.description: Abstract We study the problem of constructing coresets for clustering problems with time series data. This problem has gained importance across many fields including biology, medicine, and economics due to the proliferation of sensors for real-time measurement and rapid drop in storage costs.

arxiv-2207-09531.title: LR-Net: A Block-based Convolutional Neural Network for Low-Resolution Image Classification
arxiv-2207-09531.creator: Ashkan Ganj 1 \text{Ashkan Ganj}^{1} , Mohsen Ebadpour 2 \text{Mohsen Ebadpour}^{2} , Mahdi Darvish 1 \text{Mahdi Darvish}^{1} , Hamid Bahador 1 , ∗ \text{Hamid Bahador}^{1,*}
arxiv-2207-09531.description: Abstract The success of CNN-based architecture on image classification in learning and extracting features made them so popular these days, but the task of image classification becomes more challenging when we apply state of art models to classify noisy and low-quality images.

arxiv-2212-12638.title: Dimensionality-confined superconductivity within SrNbO 3 -SrTiO 3 heterostructures
arxiv-2212-12638.creator: Haoran Wei, Shengru Chen, Yuting Zou, Yuxin Wang, Meng Yang, Qinghua Zhang, Lin Gu, Kun Jiang, Er-Jia Guo, Zhi Gang Cheng
arxiv-2212-12638.description: Abstract Interfaces between transition-metal oxides are able to host two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs) and exhibit exotic quantum phenomena. Here we report the observation of superconductivity below 230 mK for the heterostructure composed of SrNbO 3 (SNO) and SrTiO 3 (STO).

arxiv-2305-03905.title: Generalized hybrid natural inflation
arxiv-2305-03905.creator: Teruyuki Kitabayashi
arxiv-2305-03905.description: Abstract Although the hybrid natural inflation is a successful inflation model, the symmetry breaking scale in the model should be large for a negative value of the running of the scalar spectral index. This study proposed a generalized hybrid natural inflation model that can realize a low-scale inflation with a negative value of the running of the scalar spectral index.

arxiv-2310-08164.title: Interpreting Learned Feedback Patterns in Large Language Models
arxiv-2310-08164.creator: Luke Marks † {}^{\;\;{\dagger}} , Amir Abdullah † ♢ {}^{\;\;{\dagger}\>\diamondsuit} , Clement Neo † , Rauno Arike † David Krueger □ , Philip Torr ‡ , Fazl Barez ‡ {}^{\;\;{\ddagger}}
arxiv-2310-08164.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is widely used to train large language models (LLMs). However, it is unclear whether LLMs accurately learn the underlying preferences in human feedback data. We coin the term Learned Feedback Pattern (LFP) for patterns in an LLM’s activations learned during RLHF that improve its performance on the fine-tuning task.

arxiv-2404-01462.title: OpenChemIE: An Information Extraction Toolkit For Chemistry Literature
arxiv-2404-01462.creator: Vincent Fan, Yujie Qian, Alex Wang, Amber Wang, Connor W. Coley, Regina Barzilay
arxiv-2404-01462.description: Abstract Information extraction from chemistry literature is vital for constructing up-to-date reaction databases for data-driven chemistry. Complete extraction requires combining information across text, tables, and figures, whereas prior work has mainly investigated extracting reactions from single modalities. In this paper, we present OpenChemIE to address this complex challenge and enable the extraction of reaction data at the document level.

arxiv-2411-05716.title: CLASSIFICATION OF ( ρ , τ , σ \rho,\tau,\sigma )-DERIVATIONS OF TWO-DIMENSIONAL LEFT-SYMMETRIC DIALGEBRAS
arxiv-2411-05716.creator: Basdouri Imed 1 , Bouzid Mosbahi 2
arxiv-2411-05716.description: Abstract . We introduce and study a generalized form of derivations for dendriform algebras, specifying all admissible parameter values that define these derivations. Additionally, we present a complete classification of generalized derivations for two-dimensional left-symmetric dialgebras over the field 𝕂 \mathbb{K} . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 17A60,17A99,17A36,68W30 1. arxiv-2509-18745.title: Spin defects in hexagonal boron nitride as two-dimensional strain sensors
arxiv-2509-18745.creator: Z. Mu, Z. Zhang, J. Fraunié, C. Robert, G. Seine, B. Gil, G. Cassabois, V. Jacques
arxiv-2509-18745.description: Abstract Lattice deformation is a powerful way to engineer the properties of two-dimensional (2D) materials, making their precise measurement an important challenge for both fundamental science and technological applications. Here, we demonstrate that boron-vacancy (V − B {}_{\text{B}}^{-} ) color centers in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) enable quantitative strain sensing with sub-micrometer spatial resolution.

arxiv-2510-21840.title: Improving the physics of video generation with VJEPA-2 reward signal
arxiv-2510-21840.creator: Jianhao Yuan Xiaofeng Zhang Felix Friedrich Nicolas Beltran-Velez, Melissa Hall Reyhane Askari-Hemmat Xiaochuang Han, Nicolas Ballas, Michal Drozdzal Adriana Romero-Soriano
arxiv-2510-21840.description: Abstract This is a short technical report describing the winning entry of the PhysicsIQ Challenge, presented at the Perception Test Workshop at ICCV 2025. 1 Introduction State-of-the-art video generative models [ 1 , 11 , 5 , 6 , 3 , 10 ] exhibit severely limited physical understanding, and often produce implausible videos.

arxiv-2512-15012.title: Isomorphism between Jacobi forms of index D 2 ​ n + 1 D_{2n+1} and elliptic modular forms of level 2 2
arxiv-2512-15012.creator: Shuichi Hayashida
arxiv-2512-15012.description: Abstract . There are three aims in this paper: (i) We show an isomorphism between Jacobi forms of index D 2 ​ n + 1 D_{2n+1} (lattice index) and elliptic modular forms of level 2 2 . (ii) We give an explicit formula of Fourier coefficients of Jacobi-Eisenstein series of index D 2 ​ n + 1 D_{2n+1} .

arxiv-2602-15023.title: Gravitational Wave Echoes of the First Order Phase Transition in a Kination-Induced Big Bang
arxiv-2602-15023.creator: and Evangelos I. Sfakianakis
arxiv-2602-15023.description: Abstract Gravitational waves (GWs) produced during first-order phase transitions (FOPTs) in the early universe provide a powerful probe of nonstandard cosmological histories. We study GW production from a FOPT ending a kination-dominated epoch in the Kination-Induced Big Bang scenario, in which a period of kination domination terminates through a phase transition that reheats the universe into radiation domination.

europmc-pmc4834578.creator: de Paiva CS, Jones DB, Stern ME, Bian F, Moore QL, Corbiere S, Streckfus CF, Hutchinson DS, Ajami NJ, Petrosino JF, Pflugfelder SC.
europmc-pmc4834578.description: There is mounting evidence that the microbiome has potent immunoregulatory functions. We assessed the effects of intestinal dysbiosis in a model of Sjögren syndrome (SS) by subjecting mice to desiccating stress (DS) and antibiotics (ABX). We characterized the conjunctival,...

pmc-10725111.title: “I base my life on sadness”: Apparently paradoxical sources of resilience among young Haitians
pmc-10725111.creator: Kristine Elvevold Andreassen, Anna Luise Kirkengen, May-Lill Johansen
pmc-10725111.description: Haitian expressions of resilience also hold deep knowledge of human vulnerability. This longitudinal, qualitative study with young Haitians from urban shantytowns combines ethnographic and participatory methods to explore the complexities behind such idioms. Artistic and creative products made by or with the youth facilitated interviews, focus group discussions, and workshops.

pmc-11282712.title: Vitamin D deficiency in patients with retinal vein occlusion: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11282712.creator: Kimia Daneshvar, Mohammadreza Akhlaghi, Shila Iranpour, Matin Irajpour, Mohsen Pourazizi
pmc-11282712.description: BackgroundThis review aims to substantiate the correlation between vitamin D and retinal vein occlusion (RVO) within the medical literature.MethodA systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted in PubMed, SCOPUS, Web of Science, and Embase until December 10th, 2023. A meticulous literature search was undertaken to identify and analyze all observational-analytical papers reporting vitamin D levels in RVO patients.

pmc-11320683.title: Purtscher-like retinopathy: Case report of a rare complication of acute on chronic pancreatitis
pmc-11320683.creator: Ginimal Bandaralage Kavinda Deshapriya Bandara, Duminda Subasinghe, Chanika Gamage, Pradeepa Siriwardene, Nilesh Fernandopulle
pmc-11320683.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Purtscher’s retinopathy is an occlusive micro-vasculopathy causing sudden onset visual loss in trauma. Similar retinal appearance is observed as a rare complication of acute pancreatitis which is identified as Purtscher-like retinopathy (PulR). We report the case of a 15-year-old girl diagnosed to have acute on chronic pancreatitis who noticed a sudden onset loss of vision in the left eye and was found to have significantly diminished visual acuity.

pmc-11356754.title: The Phase Change Heat of Water in the Pore Space of Rocks Based on DSC Studies
pmc-11356754.creator: Piotr Stępień, Edyta Spychał, Edyta Nartowska
pmc-11356754.description: This research investigates the phase change behavior of water within the pore space of Devonian carbonate rock samples using Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) across a temperature range of −80 to 0 °C. This study focuses on dolomite and limestone samples, all with porosities below 3%, an area not extensively covered in previous literature.

pmc-11631088.title: Australian parents’ attitudes, perceptions and supply of alcohol to adolescents: a national cross-sectional survey
pmc-11631088.creator: Jacqueline A Bowden, Ashlea Bartram, Nathan J Harrison, Christina A Norris, Susan Kim, Simone Pettigrew, Ian Olver, Rebecca Jenkinson, Marina Bowshall, Caroline Miller, Robin Room
pmc-11631088.description: Parental supply of alcohol to adolescents is associated with increased risk of subsequent adolescent alcohol use and harms, so identifying factors associated with parents’ decision-making is critical. This study examined how parental supply is associated with attitudes toward adolescent alcohol use, perceived norms of parental supply, perceived behavioural control and perceived acceptable age to drink alcohol.

pmc-11644435.title: 3D Printing of Continuous Basalt Fiber-Reinforced Composites: Characterization of the In-Plane Mechanical Properties and Anisotropy Evaluation
pmc-11644435.creator: Marco Zanelli, Giulia Ronconi, Nicola Pritoni, Andrea D’Iorio, Monica Bertoldo, Valentina Mazzanti, Francesco Mollica
pmc-11644435.description: Usage of continuous fibers as a reinforcement would definitely increase the mechanical properties of 3D-printed materials. The result is a continuous fiber-reinforced composite obtained by additive manufacturing that is not limited to prototyping or non-structural applications. Among the available continuous reinforcing fibers, basalt has not been extensively studied in 3D printing.

pmc-12403286.title: Analysis of the efficacy of conventional, skeletal and invisible orthodontic appliance for upper molar distalization in Class II Malocclusion patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12403286.creator: Yuchen Huang, Yanfang Wang, Yutong Lu, Xinying Su, Yonghua Lei
pmc-12403286.description: Background/ObjectivesTo assess the efficacy of conventional, skeletal and invisible orthodontic appliance for maxillary first molar distalization.MethodsOn February 14, 2023, an electronic search was conducted to review molar distalization using conventional, skeletal and invisible appliance, and two updated searches were conducted on August 31, 2023 and November 31,2024.

pmc-12664368.title: Mechanistic and functional characterization of ABTB2 as a novel target for pancreatic cancer therapy
pmc-12664368.creator: Nan Lyu, Olamide T. Olaoba, Qiongling Wang, Harinarayanan Janakiraman, Xinjian Liu, Ernest Ramsay Camp, Kun Cheng, Eric T. Kimchi, Yi Miao, Kevin F. Staveley-O’Carroll, Guangfu Li
pmc-12664368.description: BTB/POZ domain-containing proteins are increasingly recognized for their context-dependent roles in cancer, acting as either tumor suppressors or oncogenic drivers depending on the cancer type. Among them, the function of ankyrin repeat and BTB domain-containing protein 2 (ABTB2) in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), a highly lethal malignancy, has remained unexplored.

pmc-12800603.title: Decoding e-waste challenges with hybrid AHP and ISM Model approach: An initiative towards a cleaner future in India
pmc-12800603.creator: Ashok Kumar Singhdeo, Sushanta Tripathy, Deepak Singhal, Rabindra Narayan Mahapatra, Sourav Datta, PRANAV PRASHANT DAGWAR
pmc-12800603.description: BackgroundE-waste has rapidly become the fastest growing waste stream in the world, posing serious threats to environmental sustainability and the global agenda for a cleaner, greener, and more prosperous future. Countries that are relatively new to e-waste management as India, face significant challenges in identifying and addressing the barriers to effective mitigation efforts.

pmc-12821992.title: Fecal microbiota transplantation to reduce immune activation in ART-treated people with HIV with low CD4/CD8 ratio: protocol for the single-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled Gutsy study (CIHR/CTN PT038)
pmc-12821992.creator: Stéphane Isnard, Carolina A Berini, Seema Nair Parvathy, Hansen Feng, Orthy Aiyana, Léna Royston, Tsoarello Mabanga, Peter L Lakatos, Talat Bessissow, Marina B Klein, Bertrand Lebouché, Cecilia T Costiniuk, Bertrand Routy, Michael S Silverman, Jean-Pierre Routy
pmc-12821992.description: BackgroundDespite antiretroviral therapy (ART) controlling HIV viral replication, people with HIV (PWH) remain at risk for inflammatory non-AIDS comorbidities. Factors contributing to comorbidities in PWH on ART include spontaneous release of HIV products, CMV co-infection, microbial translocation, and gut dysbiosis, each driving systemic T-cell activation.

pmc-13214414.title: Helicobacter pylori infection, a risk factors for pulmonary tuberculosis: prevalence, associated factors and clinical profile among treatment-naive tuberculosis patients in Yaounde-Cameroon
pmc-13214414.creator: Caporal Mih Kahabiné, Claire Françoise Bitchong Ekono, Laure Brigitte Kouitcheu Mabeku
pmc-13214414.description: BackgroundThe persistence of gastric inflammation in Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection profoundly alters gastric immune response and predispose to gastric hypochlorhydria that may be a risk factor for other infections. This study sought to determine potential risk factors and clinical profile associated with prevalence of H. pylori among newly diagnosed pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) patients in Cameroon.

pmc-13243098.title: Rapid early hematological response in a newly diagnosed patient with very severe aplastic anemia: a case report of high-dose romiplostim, hetrombopag and IST combination therapy
pmc-13243098.creator: Liangkui Luo, Kaikai Huang, Yanbin Pang
pmc-13243098.description: BackgroundVery severe aplastic anemia (VSAA) is a life-threatening bone marrow failure syndrome. For patients ineligible for allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT), effective treatments that induce rapid responses remain limited. This case report describes a young VSAA patient who achieved an exceptionally rapid trilineage response to first-line therapy with high-dose romiplostim (ROMI), hetrombopag, and standard immunosuppressive therapy (IST).

pmc-13431963.title: Regulating Ligand‐to‐Metal Charge Transfer in UiO‐66(Zr)‐NH2 With Site‐Isolated Cu+ Centers for Efficient Photocatalytic H2O2 Generation
pmc-13431963.creator: Aneek Kuila, Khaled Dassouki, Aditya Swarup Lal, Ambili Ramanthrikkovil Variyam, Nirmalendu Sekhar Mishra, Eddy Dumas, Nadav Amdursky, Nathalie Steunou, Yaron Paz
pmc-13431963.description: Site‐isolated metal centers within metal‐organic frameworks (MOFs) offer a promising strategy to regulate charge–transfer dynamics and enhance photocatalysis. Here, we investigate the influence of atomically dispersed Cu ions on the photophysics and photocatalytic activity of the zirconium‐based MOF UiO‐66(Zr)‐NH2. Cu was incorporated via wet impregnation, producing Cu@UiO‐66(Zr)‐NH2 composites with preserved crystallinity.

pmc-13491244.title: Cretaceous moss–cyanobacteria association reveals trophic interactions in polar forests of Antarctica
pmc-13491244.creator: Zane Walker, Alexander C Bippus, Ari Iglesias, Selena Y Smith, Brian A Atkinson
pmc-13491244.description: Summary Through symbiotic associations with microbes, mosses play many important ecological roles in terrestrial ecosystems, such as facilitating trophic interactions and nitrogen cycling. However, little is known about interactions between mosses and microbes in past ecosystems. Here, we characterize a permineralized moss with epiphytic cyanobacteria and tubular hyphae from the Cretaceous of Antarctica.
